entries.title: Adding a computer by its address says where it got stuck
entries.body: When a computer added by its address cannot be reached, Devices now says which step stopped and on which port: reading its SSH key, signing in or sending Infinitary. It names the private network between the two computers as a thing to check, and points to Run a command there, which works where SSH from here does not. On a server started by a command, the link command also prints the firewall line Devices shows in a window.

picture.alt: The address form in Settings, Devices after a failed add, saying it could not read the computer's SSH key on port 22, what to check, and to add it with Run a command there.
